alt: 左邊女子把棕色手提包放在玄關桌上；右邊同一張桌子已空，她驚訝地掀起桌布尋找。
scene_prompt: Two cleanly separated wordless moments of the same home entry table: left small scene shows an adult placing a distinctive warm brown handbag on the bare table and turning away; right larger scene shows that same adult returning, wide-eyed with open palms, lifting the table cloth corner and looking underneath, because the bag has mysteriously vanished. Match all furnishings exactly, no culprit shown, no wings or flying objects, no text, clocks or arrows.
